title: Plate laser cutting + CNC drilling of flange bolt holes
description: Plate laser cutting + CNC drilling of flange bolt holes capability for titanium components
processDescription: Fiber laser cutting of titanium uses a focused 1 µm wavelength beam to melt and expel material through a coaxial assist gas jet. The narrow (0.1–0.3 mm) and small heat-affected zone make it suitable for precision profiles in sheet and thin-plate titanium components, specifically for flange. Precision flange for Aerospace, Chemical, Oil & Gas present unique challenges: Large diameter (up to 600 mm) with bolt hole pattern PCD tolerance ±0.1 mm. Face flatness critical for seal integrity.
heatControl: Coaxial N₂ (99.999%) assist gas at 12–20 bar prevents titanium oxidation by displacing oxygen. Laser power modulation controls heat input to minimize HAZ to 0.05–0.15 mm.
flatnessControl: Face flatness critical for seal integrity. Sequenced bolt-hole drilling pattern (opposite poles) prevents flange warpage.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for Plate laser cutting + CNC drilling of flange bolt holes, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
